from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path
program='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    """Copy the small non-background shape into every zero-only placement."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(x for row in grid for x in row if x != 0)
    color = min(counts, key=counts.get)
    points = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == color]
    r0 = min(r for r, c in points)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in points)
    shape = [(r-r0, c-c0) for r, c in points]
    sh = max(r for r, c in shape) + 1
    sw = max(c for r, c in shape) + 1
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for ar in range(h-sh+1):
        for ac in range(w-sw+1):
            cells = [(ar+dr, ac+dc) for dr, dc in shape]
            if all(grid[r][c] == 0 for r, c in cells):
                for r, c in cells:
                    out[r][c] = color
    return out
'''
